meta.note: Trimmed geometry/style tree for the two canonical PDP frames + state deltas. The Figma plugin export omits lineHeight, letterSpacing, fontStyle, effects, individual stroke weights, and image bytes. bbox is relative to the page frame.

Desktop buy-box selected state: "M" label is #FFFFFF but the M chip frame has no fill (desktop only; mobile S chip fills #000000 correctly).
Desktop gallery row 2 right tile image is 400x400 inside a 400x535.71 tile; row 3 images are oversized (1050x1050, 2225x2979) and clipped.
Recommendation photo rectangles (246x440, 258x461, 254x455, 234x419) do not match their 250x447 holders.
Mobile default hero (16:6233) has no image fill, only #DFDFDF placeholder.
Mobile footer (16:6265) uses absolute positioning: newsletter heading at x=1179 (off-canvas), brand below the link columns.
Desktop newsletter field (2044:2715) has no border; mobile field (16:6293) has 1px #000000.

Mobile overlay frames (16:7270/16:8009/16:8341) are built on an older mobile PDP background, not on 16:6217.

children.name: Minimalist in the front, unforgettable from the back. This sleek black mini dress combines an effortless A-line shift silhouette with a bold, deeply scooped racerback cut. Designed to drape smoothly with a subtle satin-matte sheen, it’s the ultimate statement piece for warm nights out, cocktail parties, and modern minimalist wardrobes.
